cds.title: Rhodes College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (Excel, Institutional Research)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class; the file is the 'New Update' posted 2026-05): 5,682 applied, 2,927 admitted (51.5%), 494 enrolled. The residency rows add up to the totals (applicants 936 in-state + 2,500 out-of-state + 2,239 international + 7 unknown; admits 637 + 1,866 + 424 + 0; enrolled 144 + 275 + 71 + 4 unknown). International first-years: 2,239 applied, 424 admitted (18.9%), 71 enrolled in the C1 table (78 degree-seeking nonresident first-years in B2). SAT submitted by 19.83% (98 students) and ACT by 35.02% (173) of enrolled first-years; the SAT/ACT ranges are the CDS figures for those who submitted (the SAT 75th percentiles for reading/writing and math are printed as 737.5 and 767.5). The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (stored as fractions in the Excel file, shown here as percents); the average GPA of 3.75 comes from 85.22% of first-years. Rhodes ticks the 'Class rank' factor as Very Important. The early decision counts (357 applied, 195 admitted) are the CDS C21 figures. Undergraduate enrollment (1,739) and the nonresident count (172) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures (B1/B2); degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates are 160.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set, whose G1 table is headed 'FULL 2025-2026 academic year': tuition $58,272, required fees $810, food and housing $14,336. Estimated expenses (G5): books and supplies $1,200, transportation $1,300, other $1,500 (other shown = transportation + other). Nonresident aid (CDS H6): the college's own need-based and non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 158 nonresident undergraduates received it, $7,915,377 in total, average $50,097 (2025-26 figures).
